description: A painted bedroom interior. An open, worn suitcase-style portable record player in the centre plays a black vinyl record. A stack of record sleeves lies on the floor at right; the top sleeve has a pink and green portrait of a dark-haired man. At left, a pair of legs in a green skirt, white socks and white-and-brown saddle shoes stand near a bed with rumpled sheets. A brown loafer is in the lower right foreground, a lamp sits at top right, and a poster hangs on the wall at top left. No legible text is visible.
